resources.string: No chest strap? %1$s can read your overnight HRV, resting heart rate and sleep from your Garmin watch, using your own Garmin Personal API key. Workouts are still created on Intervals.icu.
Create your key on Garmin Connect
The key stays on this phone only, encrypted. %1$s uses it to read your own Garmin data for your personal use, never shares it and never includes it in backups.
Connected, but no night with HRV in the last 30 days: wear your watch in bed.
Garmin rejected the key: it may have expired or been deleted. Create a new one and enter it again.
Garmin is limiting requests: try again later.
